summary: John's 1st cousin 5x removed (Kingston branch); Wyoming Seminary treasurer, bank founder and Free Soil/anti-slavery-extension organizer.
bio: Alexander J. Pringle (1824-1881), of the Kingston branch, was a trustee and treasurer of Wyoming Seminary, a founder of a Wilkes-Barre savings bank, and an organizer in 1856 of the Luzerne County party opposing the extension of slavery into free territories.
